## Primary efficacy and harms reports

- ROCKET-AF, Patel et al.: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21830957/
- RE-LY, Connolly et al., original public HTML; Statistical Analysis and Bleeding sections:
  https://www.nejm.org/doi/abs/10.1056/NEJMoa0905561
- ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48, Giugliano et al.: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24251359/
- ARISTOTLE, Granger et al.: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21870978/
- COMBINE AF IPD comparator, Carnicelli et al.:
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8800560/

## Screening checks and corroboration

- START-Portugal registry (observational cohort): https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03977363
- Weitz et al. randomized phase-II edoxaban study: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20694273/
- Sponsor listing binding randomized DU176b-C-J225 to NCT00829933:
  https://www.daiichisankyo.com/alias/pc/rd/clinical_trials/list/
- Sponsor-supplied data-request listing for that trial:
  https://www.clinicalstudydatarequest.com/Posting.aspx?ID=3905
- ENTICED-AF recruiting institution's trial description:
  https://www.mayo.edu/research/clinical-trials/cls-20492208
- ELIMINATE-AF primary design paper: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/clc.22918
- Thoracoscopic ablation registry: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04121767
- Early postcardiac-surgery randomized trial: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42610036/
- ERTEMIS registry: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05540587

Registry-shell limitations are recorded in README.md. Family/record contradictions
are findings against the pinned review's own simultaneous states; the calculations
in audit.py do not depend on changes to these external registry pages.
